_comment: One document per proprietary variant. sha256 is of the exact bytes of file (LF). reaccept: major = a new major version needs re-acceptance, never = any accepted version keeps the product running. gated_units get the 10-eula-gate.conf ExecCondition drop-in and are started by aither-eula release. Regenerate a sha with: aither-eula hash <file>. grandfather_if: absolute paths that only an ALREADY-RUN product writes (garg-firstboot.sh touches /etc/gargbot/firstboot.done); a box that has one and no recorded decision is grandfathered (the product keeps running, setup still offers the terms). Never list a path an ungated unit writes on a new box.
